mapper.select: SELECT g.id, CASE WHEN g.chat_mode = 'p2p' THEN ( SELECT m.name FROM t_sys_feishu_chat_member m WHERE m.chat_id = g.id AND m.member_id != g.app_id LIMIT 1 ) ELSE g.name END as name, g.description, g.avatar_url as avatarUrl, g.owner_id as ownerId, g.chat_mode as chatMode, g.member_count as memberCount, g.status, g.create_time as createTime, g.update_time as updateTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_sys_feishu_chat_message m WHERE m.chat_id = g.id) as messageCount, (SELECT MAX(m.create_time) FROM t_sys_feishu_chat_message m WHERE m.chat_id = g.id) as lastMessageTime FROM t_sys_feishu_chat_group g WHERE g.app_id = #{appId} and exists(select id from t_sys_feishu_chat_member m where m.chat_id=g.id and m.name=#{username}) ORDER BY lastMessageTime DESC
